Kerala CM Writes to Congress Chief on Police Action Against Students

Kerala Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has written to Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge regarding police action against students from the Students' Federation of India (SFI). The letter details the circumstances of the action taken against the SFI students. The specific nature of the police action and the reasons cited by the Chief Minister were communicated to Kharge.
